sources.description: Iran pressed ahead with attacks on Arab states in the Persian Gulf even after Israel signaled it would refrain from hitting the Islamic Republic’s energy infrastructure, fueling volatility in markets roiled by the war in the oil-rich region.

sources.title: Takaichi Navigates Trump's Pearl Harbor Jibe in DC Visit
sources.description: Despite a Pearl Harbor jibe from President Donald Trump, PM Sanae Takaichi showed Japan’s deep ties with the US — and her own agility on the world stage — during her first visit to Washington as a national leader. Alastair Gale has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: Economists Pivot to See ECB Hikes While Diverging on First Move
sources.description: Economists are shifting to align with the market view that European Central Bank interest-rate hikes are inevitable within months.

sources.title: Rühl: US Almost Out of Options to Keep Oil Price Low
sources.description: Attacks on oil and gas infrastructure in the Arabian Gulf have escalated in the past two days. After a rebuke from President Trump, Israel says it will no longer target energy assets after its attack on an Iranian gas field sparked retaliatory strikes, cause oil and gas prices to surge. Crystol Energy Global Advisor, Christof Rühl, says the US is running out of methods to keep the oil price low if the Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened. He spokes to Joumanna Bercetche on Horizons Middle East and Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: European Gas Falls as US, Israel Seek to Ease Iran War Concerns
sources.description: European natural gas fell after Israel and the US sought to ease concerns about further attacks on Persian Gulf energy facilities.

digest.episode_title: 每日中国博易名报摘要
digest.episode_summary: 今日聚焦能源市场、伊朗战争动态及日本外交活动。
digest.lead: 今天，油价面临长期上涨的风险，而美国和以色列则在寻求缓解对伊朗战争的担忧。

stories.headline: 油市面临‘更高更久’风险：萨乔银行警告
stories.summary: 萨乔银行表示，由于中东局势紧张，原油市场可能面临持续上涨的压力。该机构指出，如果波斯湾的能源基础设施受到攻击，油价可能会进一步攀升。
stories.why_it_matters: 这提醒投资者注意潜在的风险，并影响全球能源价格和经济活动。

stories.headline: Greg Brew：美国陷入伊朗战争的战略陷阱
stories.summary: Greg Brew认为，尽管以色列表示不会打击伊朗的能源设施，但伊朗仍在继续对波斯湾周边国家发动攻击。这表明美国在应对这场战争时可能陷入了战略困境。
stories.why_it_matters: Brew的观点为理解当前局势提供了新的视角，并强调了国际关系中的复杂性。

stories.headline: Greg Brew：美国的战略陷阱——伊朗战争
stories.summary: Greg Brew在播客中讨论了美国在应对伊朗战争时所面临的困境，指出以色列的声明未能阻止伊朗对能源设施的攻击。
stories.why_it_matters: 这个故事揭示了国际政治中的微妙动态，并可能影响未来的外交决策。

stories.headline: 伊朗继续在波斯湾发动袭击
stories.summary: 尽管以色列表示将避免打击伊朗的能源资产，但伊朗仍在对阿拉伯国家进行攻击，导致市场动荡加剧。
stories.why_it_matters: 这突显了当前局势的紧张程度，并可能影响全球能源供应和价格。

stories.headline: Takaichi女士在访问华盛顿期间巧妙应对特朗普的珍珠港言论
stories.summary: 尽管美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对日本进行了珍珠港式的批评，但首相山田香织展示了日本与美国之间的深厚联系，并展示了她作为国家领导人的灵活性。
stories.why_it_matters: 这个故事展示了外交关系中的微妙平衡和应对策略。

stories.headline: 经济学家转向认为欧洲央行将在数月内加息
stories.summary: 经济学家们正在转向支持市场观点，即欧洲中央银行将在几个月内进行利率上调。
stories.why_it_matters: 这可能会影响全球货币政策，并对金融市场产生重大影响。
